llm_contract: 1. Run `wobot describe --json` as your first action.
2. Never edit source files directly — use `wobot mutate --spec`.
3. Never call toolchain binaries directly — use wobot wrappers.
4. Use `wobot context` for file discovery instead of Grep/Glob.
5. Profiles: solo (auto mechanical+semantic), team (auto mechanical only), regulated (all require approval).
